Hop by hop: the server closes a connection whose request body it left unread. Caddy drops the header.

R128. Hop by hop: the body is over the route's 16 KiB cap and its end (the last chunk) had not arrived when the 413 was written, so the server drains it and closes. Next read the whole body before the route ran. Sent in one write, the same request keeps the connection on both servers. Caddy drops the header.
